title: Medulloblastoma Online Video-based Exercise Pilot Study
official: Medulloblastoma Online Video-based Exercise Pilot Study (MOVE)
summary: In this study, the investigators test whether it is possible to deliver an exercise intervention via video meetings to children and adolescents who have completed therapy for medulloblastoma. The exercise sessions will be individualized and offered three times weekly during 12 weeks.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria: Completed therapy for medulloblastoma, including craniospinal radiation therapy, within 36 months before study entry.

\-

Exclusion Criteria: Inability to walk without support. Progressive disease.

\-
